{{Top}}
A '''gravity generator''' was a utility item that enabled a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to create a localized [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] swell, the reverse effect of a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine. This had the result of increasing the weight of an enemy, thereby slowing their movement.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.
